name: Rytr
tagline: Rytr is an AI writing tool that generates blog posts, product descriptions, social captions, email templates, and marketing copy from short prompts using 40+ content-type templates. At a lower price point than Jasper or Copy.ai, it's popular with freelancers and small businesses that need consistent content output without a large budget. Its built-in tone selector and language support across 30+ languages make it flexible for international content teams.
